decisions.reason: The chart visualization plugin still fits the firm's web-GIS stack, but as a specialized add-on it could more easily be folded into broader platform functionality than the core products.
The GIS solution platform is central to the firm's strategy and reusable architecture approach, so withdrawing it would run against both its positioning and customer integration logic.
Mobile field data capture remains a strong fit with enterprise geospatial workflows for public and private clients, although mobile products require ongoing maintenance and can face portfolio review.

The search extension complements the firm's modular web map offering, but as a narrower feature component it has a somewhat higher chance of being retired or absorbed into another product than the more strategic offerings.
